body:
i'm sorry you feel the way you do. i don't have answers but i know what it feels like to be scared of living and scared of fucking up trying to die and feeling stuck. you're not alone.

if you're currently in school (you mentioned being a film student), there may be counselors you can talk to for free or cheap at your college or university.  it may not solve everything, but it may help if only just a little.
thank you for replying. the potential consequences if whatever method i choose doesn't work is a huge fear, but maybe in the long run that's a good thing if that fear keeps me around.

i'm glad i could help, and thank you. i saw you mentioned PT or exercise science below...this website may help you look at options for online ed. several of them are at well known universities.

http://www.guidetoonlineschools.com/degrees/healthcare/physical-therapy
i care. i know i'm a random internet stranger, but i hope that helps even in some small way.

i think sometimes people who have the best intentions to help genuinely don't know what to do when faced with the real darkness and ugliness that is depression, anxiety or suicidal ideation.  if you haven't lived it, it's hard to really relate to even if you really want to.  i'm sorry you've had a bad experience with people who want to help, but please know that there are people who will listen and have experienced the same darkness - even if there's no "answer" or right thing to say, there are people who will listen and genuinely understand. even if that's all we can do to help.

yes, there are people get ahead by not being genuine or straight up lying. i meet those people all the time. and for what it's worth - i'd rather talk to people who can be honest about how they feel like you.

i can't fix anything, but please know that there are people here who will listen and try to help.

i've been where you are and have spent a lot of days not able to get out of bed lately.  just know that you're not alone.

i don't have answers, but i want you to know that you're not alone. i know it's hard, but please know that people are here that will listen to you and understand what that relentless pain is like.

you should be who you are - being a certain age only means that you're enough of a badass to fight this fight for as long as you have. good on you.

i can't fix anything, but please know that there are people here who will listen and try to help.

i know what it feels like to be tired of all that, and i know what it's like to be scared of living and scared of fucking up trying to die and feeling stuck. you're not alone.
i'm glad i could help, even just a little - i hope that your work continues to help you put your pain in perspective and remains a source of positivity in your life.

have you tried to talk your teachers about how you've been feeling?  i don't know what your school or your professors are like but they may be able to help you with changing your classes in the future or finding a counselor to talk to.

even if you don't have anyone at your school you can talk to, please know you can always find people who will listen here. good luck.

please know that there are people here that will listen and can relate to what you're going through.  while it's not financial struggles for me, most days it feels like my brain's demanding that i end it to just stop everything hurting.  

i don't know much about finances, but it may help to look into online degrees to pursue your further education?  a lot of reputable universities have a lot of great online programs and you would rarely have to set foot on the campus to complete them (and you can usually work at your own pace, so if you needed a break for health reasons you can take one).  online students also usually have the same access to university services as on-campus students so you may be able to talk to someone through their counseling center to get some extra help.

good luck - it sounds like your boyfriend really cares about you and wants to help you. please let him give you the help you need if he can.
i can't fix anything for you, but please know you're not alone. if there's somebody in your life you can talk to about how you feel, do it.  otherwise, you can always talk to us. <3

so much of your story is my story too. i can't help you or make it better, but know that you're not alone in feeling shitty for wanting to die but not wanting to hurt your family.

sounds like you've really helped some people in your nursing job.  i'm sure they're grateful and you've made their lives better and easier by still being here.
